skills.name: planwork
skills.description: Shape an active coding task through focused user conversation, create a dedicated .workloop planning folder, and prepare workloop-ready plan files when the goal, scope, and done criteria are clear.
skills.short_description: Plan a task through user conversation, then make it ready for workloop.
skills.default_prompt: Use $planwork to talk through the task, create a dedicated .workloop planning folder with clear Done When and verification rules, and hand it off to $workloop only after the plan is stable.

skills.name: webp
skills.description: Use demoon84/webp-maker to convert image files to WebP or build animated WebP assets from folders of frames.
skills.short_description: Run webp-maker to create static or animated WebP assets.
skills.default_prompt: Use $webp to run demoon84/webp-maker for WebP conversion, animated WebP generation, or full pipeline processing.

skills.name: workloop
skills.description: Create or update a 1-minute same-thread coding heartbeat that keeps working on an active task in the background. Use when the user wants Codex to continue a refactor, migration, bugfix, or rollout every minute by re-reading planning files, advancing the next highest-priority step, verifying changes, updating progress artifacts, and posting concise status or blockers.
skills.default_prompt: Use $workloop to create a 1-minute same-thread coding heartbeat that reuses the active .workloop planning folder, advances the next step, verifies changes, and posts concise status.
